question: 各地区不同退款原因的退款金额分布
gold_sql: select r.region_name, re.reason, sum(distinct re.refund_amount) from refunds re left join orders o on re.order_id = o.order_id left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id left join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id group by 1,2
raw_output:
SELECT 
    r.region_name AS region,
    rf.reason AS refund_reason,
    SUM(rf.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
FROM 
    refunds rf
JOIN 
    orders o ON rf.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN 
    regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE 
    rf.status = '已退款'
GROUP BY 
    r.region_name, rf.reason
ORDER BY 
    r.region_name, refund_amount DESC
